target_customer: Riders and drivers in Mexico and Latin America (cars, motorcycles, bikes, scooters, gadgets) and insurance brokers buying B2B software
problem: Mexican consumers in underserved segments such as cyclists, scooter riders and low-mileage drivers have few affordable insurance options priced on how they actually use their vehicle.
business_model: Insurance mutual (Clupp Mutualidad) with usage-based pricing per kilometer, plus B2B SaaS for brokers

founders.name: Omar Said López Tronco
education: MSc in Risk Management (as stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an actuary, CFA charterholder and full-stack developer; winner of Mexican Insurance Research Award (2015) and Mexican Insurance Innovation Award (2017).

founders.name: Marisol Sánchez
founders.background_notes: YC page says she oversees claims and fraud detection and is president of the Mexican Insurtech Association.

competitors.name: miituo
competitors.what: Mexico City usage-based car insurance with pay per kilometer plans

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app with odometer photo capture and pricing logic; the hard parts are actuarial pricing and regulatory structure, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Operating as a licensed mutual with third party liability underwritten by ANA Seguros gives some structure, but usage-based pricing itself is copyable by incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large carriers dominated Mexican auto insurance; ANA Seguros had a usage-based program via Octo Telematics (date not found) and later became Clupp's underwriting partner for liability cover.

market_need_then: Mexico had low insurance penetration and an underserved bike, scooter and low-mileage segment; the company's own site and a coverage profile cite up to 40% lower premiums for low-mileage drivers.

branding.domain_note: Operates on clupp.com.mx (country domain), not an exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language, mobility themed, built around music genres under the Lo Que Te Mueve theme

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: aseguramos lo que te mueve (we insure what moves you)

brand_strength.rationale: Only a tagline and a campaign theme are visible on the company site; no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Clupp remains active as of the YC listing and its own site, which shows a licensed mutual selling auto, motorcycle, bike and gadget cover with pay per kilometer plans. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found. Funding is only visible in aggregators that disagree, so the company's financial trajectory cannot be judged from public sources.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and unverified: Seedtable lists a 455K USD pre-seed in 2021-12 led by G2 Momentum Capital, Caplight lists 300K (Amplifica, 2021-11) and 500K (Y Combinator, 2022-03), CB Insights says 580K total, VCBacked 500K, another listing 800K. No press release or second outlet confirmed any figure, so no round is recorded. Founding year differs across sources (2016 to 2021); YC says 2021. The miituo entry comes from an undated database page and its pay per kilometer launch date was not found; it is listed because it existed as a Mexico City usage-based insurer before the batch per that profile. Co-founders beyond the two on the YC page not checked. The coverager.com page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Completeness pass: rounds recorded from single databases (Seedtable 455K pre-seed, Caplight 500K YC round, CB Insights 30K convertible note III on 2022-04-19; CB Insights total 580K over 4 rounds). Caplight also lists 300K from Amplifica Capital in 2021-11, not recorded separately because it may overlap the Seedtable round. Amounts are not summed and no press release confirms any.
